entry.title: Chip Selloff Rolls On as Big Bank Earnings Begin
entry.summary: A selloff in chipmakers deepened on concerns about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence trade, putting pressure on equity markets as Wall Street banks kicked off the earnings season. Lori Calvasina, Head of US Equity Strategy at RBC Capital Markets, discusses her S&P outlook and market choppiness. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Revolut and Vinted Backer Sprints Raises €725 Million Fund
entry.summary: Sprints, a venture capital firm that backed Revolut early, has closed its fifth fund of €725 million ($810 million).

entry.title: Neostellar’s Willy Lee on AI Landscape Ahead of Anthropic Pre-IPO Investor Day
entry.summary: Willy Lee, Principal at Neostellar, says attention on Anthropic’s potential IPO risks obscuring broader AI investment and adoption. He cited nearly $200 billion in U.S. venture capital deployed in the first half of the year—more than 74% of the prior year’s estimated total. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Hema Parmar on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Banks Poised to Surprise Wall Street: Analyst
entry.summary: Baird Senior Research Analyst David George joins Bloomberg Open Interest to lay out why he’s bullish on upcoming bank earnings despite a risk‑off market. He explains how AI-driven capital markets may cool, why regional banks could outperform the Wall Street giants, and how post‑election consolidation and higher rates set up JPMorgan and others for upside this quarter. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Amazon Is in Talks to Buy AI Startup Decart, WSJ Reports
entry.summary: Amazon.com Inc. is in negotiations to acquire Decart AI, an artificial intelligence startup, in a deal that could be valued at around $7 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported.

entry.title: OpenAI's $70B Run Rate Meets AI's Infrastructure Challenge
entry.summary: loomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down OpenAI's latest annualized revenue, expected to reach or exceed $70 billion by the end of the year. Plus, Oracle keeps several data centers on track by relying on truck deliveries of natural gas, and a conversation with Kleiner Perkins partner Ilya Fushman on the mega AI IPO pipeline and the future of physical AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.summary: Kleiner Perkins partner Ilya Fushman says AI is still in the early stages of reshaping the economy, with opportunities extending from frontier models like Anthropic to consumer agents, autonomous vehicles and robotics. entry.title: AI Buildout is Boom 'Not Bubble,' Says Jared Gross
entry.summary: Credit markets are again becoming jittery over the prospects of more mega debt deals hitting a market already flush with financings to pay for the AI arms race. Jared Gross, Head of Institutional Portfolio Strategy at JPMorgan Asset Management, discusses AI asset allocation and why he believes the AI buildout is indeed a boom, not a bubble. (Source: Bloomberg)

He says Revolut plans to build out a full digital banking offer, from credit cards to loans, while using AI and automation to reshape how customers bank. entry.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus IPO Collapses as AI Valuation Concerns Grow
entry.summary: Firmus abandoned its attempt at one of Australia’s biggest-ever initial public offerings, after the Nvidia-backed data center company failed to lure global investors who’ve grown increasingly skittish over frothy AI valuations. (Source: Bloomberg)
